dependencies.name: Integrated MCP servers (Obsidian, Firecrawl, Context7, DataForSEO, Slack, Google Drive, Atlassian, Sentry, PostHog, Sequential Thinking, Serena, n8n-builder, n8n-executor)
dependencies.purpose: Each server enriches one specific pipeline phase — see README § Integrated MCP Servers for the full phase mapping (e.g. Firecrawl/Context7 for phase-1 research, DataForSEO for content-project keyword data, n8n-builder/n8n-executor for automation phases).
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The corresponding phase proceeds without that data source — e.g. no vault search for prior art without Obsidian, no external doc scraping without Firecrawl, no SEO keyword data without DataForSEO. The pipeline itself doesn't fail; that phase is just less informed.

replacement.suggestion: gather that phase's research or data manually outside Claude and paste it into the session
replacement.warning: each of these MCP servers already exists and is maintained by its vendor (or another Rhize plugin); there's no code to reinvent here, just an integration to connect. Manual gathering has to be repeated every launch instead of automated once.

dependencies.name: Integrated external skills (obsidian-second-brain:vault-search/vault-research, grill-me, write-a-prd, seo-aeo-geo:*, brand-voice:*, n8n-automation, engineering:system-design/architecture, tdd, prd-to-issues, simplify)
dependencies.purpose: Each skill is invoked at a specific pipeline phase to do that phase's specialized work — see README § Integrated Skills for the full phase mapping.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: If the plugin providing a skill isn't installed or enabled, that phase's step is skipped, or done with the launcher's own generic prompting instead of the specialist skill's tuned workflow.

replacement.suggestion: have Claude do that phase's work directly, without the specialist skill
replacement.warning: these are all skills from other Rhize (or third-party) plugins that already encode a tuned workflow for their specialty. Falling back to generic prompting loses that tuning — install the plugin that ships the skill instead of trying to replicate its prompt engineering ad hoc.

artifacts.purpose: Written PRDs (and their gap-analysis v2 revisions) produced by /write-prd and /grill-prd.
GSD v2 planning docs (PROJECT.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, ROADMAP.md, STATE.md) scaffolded by /scaffold-gsd.
Copied hookify rule files (secret-leak and PR-review enforcement) for the nextjs-rhize-stack, opt-in per project.
